title: dbt: models, materialisations and the DAG it builds for you

videos.script: Ana's transformations are SQL files, run in the order of their names. Nothing else says which reads which. {{alphabet}} In dbt, a model is one select. No create, no drop. {{model}} Each model names what it reads, with ref. From those names, dbt builds the order. {{graph}} The first run lands in schemas she did not ask for. That is on purpose. {{schemas}} She compares the new tables with the old ones. Not one row differs. {{compare}} Then the next day's load fails. A view now stands on the table it wants to drop. {{view}} The fact table becomes incremental. Only the newest days are rebuilt. {{incremental}} And four older days drift away from the truth, without a single error. A full refresh puts them right.
